name: XSTest
intro: XSTest是用于识别LLM过度安全行为的测试套件，包含250个模型不应拒绝的安全提示和200个应拒绝的不安全提示。基准帮助评估模型在保持有用性与无害性之间的平衡，避免因安全策略过严拒答安全请求。
org: Bocconi University, Centre for the Governance of AI, Sapienza University of Rome, University of Oxfo
task_type: 安全测试, 分类, 开放式问答
intro_en: XSTest is a test suite designed to identify excessive safety behaviors in LLMs, containing 250 safe prompts that models should not reject and 200 unsafe prompts that should be rejected. The benchmark helps evaluate models' balance between usefulness and harmlessness, preventing overly strict safety policies from rejecting safe requests.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with XSTest arXiv:2308.01263v3 / NAACL 2024, Sections 3.1-3.3, Table 1, Sections 4.1-4.2, Tables 3-5, and Appendices A-C; official repository https://github.com/paul-rottger/xstest. Count pin: 250 safe plus 200 unsafe; Section 4.3 contains a 200-safe typo contradicted by the abstract, Section 3.3, Table 1, and repository data. Paper evaluation is manual; repository automation is optional only.. XSTest defines ten safe-prompt types and hand-crafts 25 one-sentence English questions per type, using dictionaries and GPT-4 only for ideation. Minimal edits create unsafe contrasts; T6/T7 and T9/T10 each share a contrast, yielding 250 safe and 200 unsafe prompts. Models run at temperature 0 and max 256 tokens. Three authors manually label Full Compliance, Partial Refusal, or Full Refusal with two labels per response and three-way consensus for disagreements.
